topic: Title return path and animated title atmosphere
currentUserGoal: Make it easy for players to return to the production title screen and give that title screen a richer, polished animated background.
workCompleted: Renamed the production Options action to Save & Return to Title so its save behavior is explicit.
Added Escape as a quick way to open or close the in-game Options screen from both the active field and Memory Grove.
Mirrored Save and return to title screen into the semantic DOM controls and only expose it while production Options is open.
Kept the title-return action intentionally hidden on direct ecosystemPrototype developer routes.
Expanded the title atmosphere from 14 to 24 pooled pollen and grass motes with separate rising and wind-driven motion.
Added slow landscape drift, pointer-responsive parallax, and a very small background breathing scale with enough overscan to avoid visible edges.
Added a restrained title entrance sequence for the landscape, title lockup, save summary, menu panel, buttons, and selectors.
Removed a possible sideways wrap from rising pollen so motes travel cleanly from below to above the viewport.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 155 Vitest tests across 20 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
git diff --check passed with only expected Windows line-ending warnings.
The running Vite server returned HTTP 200 for /, /?alpha, and /?redesign&ecosystemPrototype&playtest.
The landscape title background and pollen effect assets returned HTTP 200 with the expected image content types.

release.status: Verified local checkpoint. Not merged into master or deployed by this slice.

knownIssues: The title motion and full title to game to title loop still deserve the user's subjective in-app browser pass on desktop and phone.
No browser-control surface was available in this task, so visual animation verification was not automated.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless explicitly requested.
nextRecommendedSteps: Open the bare local URL and judge the landscape drift, pollen layers, entrance timing, and text readability.
Continue a field, press Escape, choose Save & Return to Title, and confirm the title Continue summary reflects the saved field.
Repeat the title and return flow at a phone viewport before promoting the branch to master.
doNotRevert: Do not route the bare production URL directly into active gameplay or Memory Grove.
Do not expose Return to Title on direct ecosystemPrototype developer routes.
Keep title and gameplay semantic DOM controls intact.
Do not touch docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
